basis: FedEx’s March 16 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found for fiscal Q3 2023, the three months ended February 28, 2023. Its consolidated table reports total revenue of $22,169 million against $23,641 million for the prior-year quarter, including other revenue and eliminations in both periods. Revenue fell 6.23% and was $289.95 million below the $22,458.95 million threshold.

coverage.detail: September 15, 2022 preliminary Q1 release. FedEx withdrew its full-year earnings forecast and projected $23.5–$24.0 billion in revenue specifically for fiscal Q2, the quarter ending in November.
September 22 Q1 release. FedEx retained the $23.5–$24.0 billion Q2 revenue range. Its longer-term dollar targets concerned cost savings.
September 22 Q1 call. Management discussed second-half cost savings and flight reductions. It gave no numeric consolidated Q3 revenue outlook.

December 20 Q2 release. The $22.8 billion revenue figure was the actual for the quarter ended November 30. The outlook covered fiscal-year EPS, tax rate and capital spending. It supplied no Q3 revenue ceiling.

December 20 Q2 call. Management expected Express and Ground volume declines to moderate by the end of Q3 and Q3 earnings to be lower than Q2 earnings. Neither statement quantified consolidated Q3 revenue.
The December earnings slides reported a 3% year-over-year revenue decline for Q2 and presented volume trends and fiscal-year guidance. They gave no numeric Q3 consolidated revenue range.

February 21 Citi investor presentation. Slide 10 anticipated continued volume softness and increasing yield pressure. The quantified operating figures included peak-season packages and flight-hour reductions. None established a Q3 consolidated revenue ceiling.

February 21 conference remarks and Q&A. Management discussed demand, pricing, cost reductions and capital spending as a percentage of revenue. It gave no dollar or percentage bound for Q3 consolidated revenue.
March 6 intervening 8-K. The filing index identifies Item 5.03 and lists Exhibits 3.1 and 3.2, with no earnings or guidance exhibit.

March 16 Q3 release, Exhibit 99.1. The three-month Total Revenue row gives $22,169 million and $23,641 million for fiscal 2023 and 2022 respectively. These are the more precise figures behind the headline GAAP amounts of $22.2 billion and $23.6 billion.
FedEx’s public newsroom timestamps the Q3 results release March 16, 2023 at 03:05 PM and announces the earnings call for later that day.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer newsroom timestamp and the March 16, 2023 dateline in Exhibit 99.1 independently identify the public release date. The exhibit identifies February 28 as the quarter end.
